mainEntity.name: What is deep-tech PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deep-tech PR is media and narrative strategy for founders whose product requires genuine technical explanation before it can be positioned: AI infrastructure, DePIN, cryptography, novel consensus mechanisms, quantum-adjacent software and similar categories. It is for founders who have found that generalist PR firms cannot get past surface-level messaging because no one on the account team has read the docs. Shilika Jain works directly with technical founders at $5K to $12K per month, building the narrative from the architecture up.

mainEntity.name: How much does deep-tech PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator typically runs $5K to $12K per month for ongoing retainer work, covering positioning, pitching and ongoing media relations. A focused launch sprint runs $15K to $40K over four to eight weeks. Full-service agencies typically charge $15K to $45K per month because the retainer funds a multi-person account team. The fractional model removes that structural overhead without reducing senior access.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you place deep-tech stories in?

acceptedAnswer.text: For AI infrastructure and developer tools: Forbes, TechCrunch, VentureBeat, AI Magazine and specialist newsletters with traction in the target community. For crypto-adjacent deep tech: CoinDesk, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks. For enterprise and B2B angles: Bloomberg Technology, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga and industry trade press. Regional: six APAC markets with native-language access. Coverage requires a genuine news hook, not a wire blast.

mainEntity.name: What does the process look like and how long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks are a technical intake and positioning sprint: reading the whitepaper, architecture docs and founder story, then building the category thesis and journalist map. Weeks three and four are the outreach and embargo setup. First coverage typically lands in weeks four to six for a prepared launch, or weeks six to eight for a project starting from no press footprint. Ongoing monthly retainer work builds compound coverage and AI-search citations.

Send a short project brief through the intent form at shilikajain.com/pages/deeptech-pr-agency and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current press footprint and a note on where the narrative leverage is, or book a 30-minute call and we plot it live. No deck required, no account-team intro call.
